summary: This bill amends the National Quantum Initiative Act to include quantum modeling and simulation in the definition of quantum information science and as a focus area for quantum information science research programs.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the National Quantum Initiative Act to include quantum modeling and simulation in the definition of quantum information science and as a research program area. While quantum computing has implications for data security and privacy, this bill focuses purely on promoting research and development in quantum molecular modeling and simulation for scientific and industrial applications, not on regulating or deregulating tech or privacy directly. Therefore, its impact on tech and privacy is negligible.
